title: Appxiom
lede: Appxiom records crashes, freezes, memory leaks, failed network calls and broken user journeys in production apps, and hands that context to coding agents through an MCP connector.

points: SDKs cover Android, iOS, Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform and the web, with extra support for React among JavaScript and TypeScript frameworks.
Goal Friction Impact: you mark goals such as signup or checkout, and each failed completion is linked to the bug behind it.
Agents can then rank bugs by how many goal completions each one cost, rather than by raw crash counts.
The MCP connector and agent Skills are live; the Skills can wire up the SDK and suggest which goals are worth tracking.
The team says Appxiom only supplies context: root cause and fix stay with the agent and developer. React Native and Shopify support are next.

sections.text: Mobile and web teams already working with coding agents who want those agents fixing the production failures that block users, instead of guessing from a stack trace or a hand-picked ticket.
